Welcome to Sacred Layers



Sacred Layers offers restorative massage and holistic bodywork designed to calm the nervous system, release tension, and support deeper reconnection with self.

Each session is created as a gentle space to slow down, soften, and restore balance through intuitive touch and nurturing care. Treatments are particularly supportive for stress, anxiety, burnout, emotional fatigue, menopause symptoms, and emotional wellbeing.



• You deserve to be deeply cared for •

Meet Maria



Hi, I’m Maria - founder and therapist at Sacred Layers.

With more than 10 years of experience in the wellness industry, I offer restorative massage and holistic bodywork designed to support deep relaxation, healing, and reconnection.

I have a Diploma in Remedial Massage Therapy since 2016, and have worked in high-end spas and wellness centers for the past decade. I have extensive experience in Balinese style massage and additionally have learnt first 2 levels of Kahuna massage, Oncology Massage, Reflexology and many other modalities.

I am an accredited member of Massage & Myotherapy Australia. 

My approach combines therapeutic touch, intuitive care, and a calming presence to create treatments that nurture my clients as a whole.

Based at Revival Health Labs in Noosaville, I offer sessions in a peaceful and welcoming space on the Sunshine Coast.

Restorative Massage

A nurturing full-body relaxation massage designed to calm the nervous system, release stress and tension, and support deep rejuvenation. Gentle to medium pressure is tailored to your individual needs using warm oil and long flowing strokes while still allowing deeper work through areas of muscular tension, particularly within the upper back, shoulders, and neck.

Perfect for those feeling overwhelmed, exhausted, emotionally depleted, or simply in need of a relaxing massage with caring touch.

For a more immersive experience, a Body Scrub Ritual can be incorporated before your massage - promoting circulation  and preparing the skin for deeper hydration from the oils used during massage for total bliss.

90 min — $208

30 min Body Scrub Ritual add-on — $80 (allowing 20 min for scrub + 10 min for shower)

Healing Bodywork

A deeply personalised and intuitive treatment designed for those seeking reconnection with themselves.

Sessions incorporate breath-work, sound therapy, energy healing and vocal release. I will be providing a guiding touch to work through layers of tension, to support emotional release and energetic stagnation in the body and nervous system in order to reach deeper awareness within.

Each experience is unique and created with intention, offering a safe and supportive space for those wishing to process emotions and explore healing on a deeper level.

This bodywork session is a co-creation with the client engaged in the process.

Please allow approximately 2 hours for this experience.

The Healing Bodywork experience is offered after an initial Restorative Massage session. This allows space for trust, comfort, and mutual resonance to develop naturally before moving into deeper layers of healing and bodywork.


Approx 2 Hours — $288

sections.originalHtml:
Oncology Massage 

Oncology Massage is gentle, specialized therapy adapted safely for anyone with a cancer diagnoses or history. It modifies pressure, positioning, and techniques to support your body through treatment, recovery, and beyond.

Benefits: 

Reduces Pain: Calms sore muscles and nerves.

Lowers Anxiety: Soothes the nervous system deeply.

Eases Fatique: Restores energy without draining you.

Relieves Nausea: Promotes comfort during tough treatments.

Improves Sleep: Helps your body rest and heal.

It's also possible to have a fully clothed Bone Marrow Production Support Sequence where a light systematic touch is designed to improve and support bone marrow production and stimulate the immune system through the principles of deep relaxation.

I hold certifications in Oncology Massage Foundation (OM1) and Oncology Massage Therapist (OM2). These specialised qualifications enable me to support people navigating cancer and other significant health challenges with greater sensitivity, care, and understanding.

What to Expect: Every session is customized to your health profile that day. The touch will be adjusted safely accommodate surgeries, ports, and medications, ensuring a deeply comforting, non-medical space to relax.

Please allow extra time for your initial appoitment. This includes a comprehensive consultation to map out your safe treatment.


60 min — $158

*Health fund rebates available, depending on your fund and level of cover.

If you’re feeling tired, overwhelmed, run down, or simply in need of deep rest, this treatment may be for you. Performed fully clothed for comfort and warmth, this gentle therapy uses light, mindful touch and still hand placements over specific areas of the body to encourage deep relaxation, comfort, and calm.

Grounded, light, gentle touch is designed to improve and support bone marrow production. The systematic touch, in a particular sequence around the body, is thought to stimulate the immune system through the principle of deep relaxation. It also supports nervous system regulation. Many people describe the experience as deeply comforting - a space to slow down, soften, and feel more settled.

Many clients experience a deep sense of rest during sessions, often drifting into a peaceful, sleep-like state that supports relaxation and restoration. Clients often report improved sleep, greater ease in the body, easier bowel movements, and an overall sense of wellbeing following sessions.


60 min — $138

A Little About Me


Healing has always been more than just physical for me. Over the years, my path has naturally evolved from spa and massage therapy into a deeper, more intuitive approach to bodywork - one that honors the connection between body, mind, emotions, nervous system, and spirit.

Originally from Estonia, I was raised during the deep Soviet era - a time shaped by silence, resilience, hard work, and emotional suppression. Growing up within those environments gave me a deep understanding of endurance, sensitivity, and the unspoken layers people often carry within themselves. In many ways, those early experiences became part of the foundation of both my strength and my healing journey.

My own healing journey has deeply shaped the way I work today. After experiencing significant health challenges and periods of personal transformation, I found myself drawn into deeper healing work - exploring emotional release, ancestral healing, embodied movement, somatic practices, and spiritual connection in a much more profound way.

Part of this journey guided me to Peru, where I worked alongside shamans and immersed myself in practices connected to ancestral healing and ancient wisdom traditions. Through these experiences, as well as shamanic de-armouring work, I began to reconnect more deeply with myself, my sensitivity, intuition, and sense of purpose.

With more than 10 years of experience in the wellness industry, including a Diploma in Remedial Massage, I bring both professional knowledge and heartfelt presence into my work. My background has been primarily within spa and holistic wellness settings, where I developed a deeply nurturing and restorative approach to bodywork.

Alongside Sacred Layers, I co-created Sacredness - offering luxurious four-hand massage experiences for clients, corporate retreats, and wellness events seeking an unique experience, where two therapists work in synchronicity to create a blissful and immersive experience. 

Through Sacred Layers, I bring together therapeutic bodywork, intuitive care, and years of spa experience into treatments designed to support the person as a whole.

My work is guided by the belief that healing often begins in the moments where we allow ourselves to slow down, listen, be present, trust, and become open to receiving. Through my own experiences, I have come to understand that healing is rarely linear - it moves through many layers, often in ways we do not expect. Sometimes even the smallest moment, insight, or shift can become the beginning of a much deeper transformation.

Over time, I’ve learned that all of these layers are sacred - even the ones that feel messy, uncertain, or uncomfortable. They are often the places where the deepest healing and growth emerge.

I also deeply believe in the power of safe, intentional touch. It helps by bringing people back into balance and connection with their bodies, softening emotional holding, and creating space for the body to naturally let go, restore and heal.

At the moment, I am also deepening my studies through Oncology Massage training, allowing me to better support people navigating cancer and other significant health challenges with greater sensitivity, care, and understanding.

Based on the Sunshine Coast, I offer treatments from Revival Health Labs Noosaville in a calm, grounded, and welcoming healing environment.


I look forward to welcoming you.

 

Maria 🤍

sections.originalHtml:
Magic Maria

I booked a 90 min massage 


Maria looked after every part of my body with love and tenderness clearly toping my vacation and the 2018 year the best way possible 


They were very considerate of my allergies and used a cream I bought from home and although it was very strong they took my wishes into consideration and gave me the best massage with the best hands I’ve felt ever which put me to sleep on two separate occasions 


I’ll be coming back to Noosa soon hopefully for another vacation and I’ll be wanting Maria back with her hands and magic touch 


I loved it 

Truly amazing


Roberto G. | Noosa, QLD

My friends and I went for on a girls weekend away. I had a 45min facial which was my first ever one. I found it very relaxing and soothing. My therapist was Maria who was very friendly. The neck and head massage was amazing.


Nicky | Noosa, QLD

Had the 2-hour body elixir  and it was wonderful. Maria has magic hands and really worked out all my sore muscles as well as totally relaxed me with the oils and facial which are included. I was completely blisses out by the end. Would definitely recommend this service.


Stephanie. M | Darwin NT

Best massage I have had in years and arguably “best massage I have ever had!” Maria is gifted, she is talented therapist and healer. I don't normally like my upper body getting massaged due to pain and tension but she really worked on this area with sensitivity.

Thank you Maria. I will be back.


Eloise.N | Darwin, NT
